subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about winning back lapsed payers. The gap is the timely part here: only 16% of gaming apps run remarketing against 59% of shopping apps, so most high-value players who open the shop, stall, and lapse are left for organic return as budgets elsewhere shift to re-engagement. And re-engaging an existing user runs 5x to 25x cheaper than new acquisition, so a recovered spender is the cheaper unit. That economics is the bar Remerge and Adikteev are measured against. Worth comparing to your current win-back mix?
angle: fresh angle: gaming-vs-shopping remarketing penetration gap (sourced) + 5x-25x re-engagement cost economics as recovery band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN gaming_midcore_hardcore retargeting: acknowledges second follow-up + references prior email in first sentence; fresh angle = remarketing penetration gap (16% gaming vs 59% shopping, AppsFlyer Top-5 Trends) plus re-engagement cost band (5x-25x cheaper than new acquisition, AppsFlyer); both numbers REAL and carried from the parent's web-verified source set, URLs in enrichment_sources; named peers reused from parent only (Remerge, Adikteev); no MobUpps figure this stage; 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y (positive stated directly).
